record.title: Verify built distributions and automate typed workspace gates
record.intent: Detect packaging errors hidden by editable source imports and preserve repeatable checks.
requirements: Build all workspace distributions and test installed wheels from outside the checkout with no editable imports.
Verify public imports, py.typed markers, CLI library composition and a synthetic evidence round trip; preserve negative controls.
Add repeatable local packaging verification and bounded CI quality checks without changing legacy scripts or accessing devices.
acceptance: Built installed distributions work independently and quality commands are reproducible.
